scripts.dev: set PORT=5173&& set BASE_PATH=/&& npm --prefix artifacts/java-exam-sprint run dev
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach((file) => fs.rmSync(file, { force: true })); const userAgent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!userAgent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
